title: Original Source Code (V1)
text: V5 form-based BASIC source (vignette("original-source")) stripped-version V1. V1 adds several pathways V5 omits: CO2 / bicarbonate / carbonate chemistry (H2CO3, HCO3, CO3, plus Na2CO3 / CaCO3 / MgCO3 complexes). TRIS buffer (HTRIS). Pyrophosphate (PP) speciation — though, see caveat . Struvite (MgNH4PO4) included Mg NH4 mass balances (V5 computes struvite SS feed back balances). Sodium-urate, ammonium-urate, potassium-urate complexes included Na/NH4/K mass balances (V5 reports SS couple back cation balance). Chloride auto-fill via electroneutrality chloride supplied (V5 requires chloride input). Inputs mmol per collection volume (V1) vs mg/dL (V5). V1’s approach unit-unambiguous need per-species atomic-weight conversion factors — see issue #2 matters. V1 V5 share stability constants core CaOx / Brushite / HAP / Uric Acid / Sodium-urate / Ammonium-urate pathways. constants differ concentrated CO2 / PP / HU pathways V5 doesn’t use anyway (e.g. P7 CO2 dissociation 0.00229 V1 vs 0.00123 V5; HU formation constant 7.943e10 V1 vs 2.78e5 V5). V1 reports activity products (APCaOx, APBr, APStru, APUA, APNaU) relative saturation ratios (RSR = AP / Ksp) Calcium Oxalate, Brushite, Struvite, Uric Acid . V5 additionally reports SS values Hydroxyapatite, Sodium Urate, Ammonium Urate, plus negative ΔGibbs energy . V5-outputs use equil2() function. V1’s iteration loop capped 500 iterations (vs 50 V5) raises warning non-convergence.

title: Original Source Code (V1)
text: Three quirks V1 source preserved verbatim equil2_v1() fidelity: Pyrophosphate disabled. reading input, V1 unconditionally sets TPP = 0 PP = 0, short-circuits entire pyrophosphate pathway. R port keeps ; users want PP chemistry can edit two TPP <- 0 / PP_var <- 0 lines R/equil2_v1.R. NH4PO4 uninitialized. V1 declares Dim NH4PO4 Double never assigns , always zero (VBA default). R port make explicit NH4PO4 <- 0. Urate-cation complexes (NaU, KU, NH4U) cation mass balance. V1 computes uses ionic strength chloride electroneutrality auto-fill, STNa / STK / STNH4 include . Effectively V1 treats trace species don’t deplete free Na, K, NH4. R port matches .
